text: Sometimes, indeed, extraordinary geniuses have broken out by the force of nature, without the assistance of education; but those instances are too rare for anybody to trust to; and even they would make a much greater figure, if they had the advantage of education into the bargain.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter XXXV, to his son, London, April 1, Old Style 1748
